criteria.criterion: negative tests: identity, key and transcript substitution rejected
real SM4-GCM record layer, not an AES test double
race detector clean on a supported platform

criteria.evidence: OpenSSL exposes no SM2MQV CLI; see docs/DEPENDENCIES.md

why_not_M2_LEGACY_VERIFIED: The race check was never executed. Per the acceptance rules, a clean race run on a supported platform is required, and a pass on Linux may not be reported as a pass on Windows either.
SM2 key agreement still lacks an independent implementation cross-check.
what_is_definitely_true: No tampering, substitution, reordering, injection or replay test was found to be accepted: all 27 structured negative cases were rejected at the expected stage, and none produced a Channel or delivered plaintext.
The traditional handshake and the record layer use real SM2/HKDF-SM3/SM4-GCM. No test double is reachable from the gateway or device binaries.
The default hybrid configuration is refused, not downgraded.
Suite 2 is advertised nowhere and accepted nowhere; no post-quantum claim is made.
may_proceed_note: Per the task's stop conditions, an open verification gap blocks a FULL PASS but does not block continuing development. M3 work may start locally; the M2 gap must be closed before any deployment or any claim of complete verification.
must_not_be_reported_as: a post-quantum or hybrid secure channel
